author: iamMrDuncan
text:
Built an alternative version of @typesafeai but on @cerebras with Qwen 3.8 27b.

Similar quality, similar performance, but vastly different cost. TypeSafe was way cheaper, and did beat Qwen on performance.

Closest we can get using LLMs I think.

Source: https://github.com/iammrduncan/typesafe-ai-benchmark
